pre_outcome_amendment: The first gold-only preparation failed balanced donor feasibility in rare answer buckets. Preserve the failed protocol in results/reviewer_revision_diagnostics. Exclude infeasible whole gold-answer buckets from both interchange arms before seeing any model prediction; retain all inputs for the expanded composition census.
scope: Post-confirmation diagnostics on frozen sources. Enumerate all six orientations of every per-source orbit unexposed to that source's training/validation and all previously examined tests; orbit is the sampling unit. Natural-state interchange preserves the recipient's complete first-step logits. Distinct-future and same-future donors are selected by exact gold answers before predictions, with orbit exclusions and no oracle-accuracy filtering. Same-gold-answer natural components can still yield off-manifold hybrids. Secondary TOST on old sources is descriptive and does not establish pre-registered equivalence. Ridge changes the objective and is a numerical sensitivity analysis, not the original same-loss certificate. No equivalence or natural relation-specific causal mechanism is presumed.
